utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much are the club dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure yet, but I can swing by the club office and check for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — could you let me know as soon as you find out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand with that—what’s the amount due and where should we send it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—I'll have to check the exact amount and where to send it. I’m a bit spaced out, but I’ll get back to you with the dues info.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, just let me know when you’ve got it and I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the club dues are due soon, so I’d probably get those in this week if you can. If you want, I can check what the exact amount is.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot — I’d rather know the exact amount before I send anything. If you can check, I can get it sorted this week.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and get the exact dues amount for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the club dues. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you tell me which location you’re paying for and whether you’ve already sent the dues?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m paying for the Maple Street location, and I haven’t sent the dues yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I heard the club dues are coming up soon—want me to pass along the details or remind you when they’re due?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn—that’d be helpful. A reminder would be appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll remind you when they’re due and pass along the details too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Leo, I’m just checking in on the club dues so we can keep everything on track. If you need a little more time, just let me know and we’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I can pay the dues this week. I’ll send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. Just send it over whenever you’re ready this week, and I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the dues amount and when it’s due? I want to make sure I have the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m a bit late—I'm not sure of the exact dues amount yet, but I can check and get back to you on when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that would help—please check the exact amount and the due date, and let me know when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m just checking on the club membership dues—what’s the total and when do they need to be paid?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d be happy to check that for you—let me confirm the total and due date, and I’ll get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard bits and pieces—are the dues due soon?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I think they’re due pretty soon—I can check the exact date and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I’d appreciate the exact date.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can take a look at the dues later—just send me the amount and due date.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay—so you want the amount and the due date, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, just the amount and due date is perfect—then I can handle it later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d like to sort out the dues—how much are they, and when do they need to be paid?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—sorry, I’m a bit foggy on the exact number. Let me check and get back to you with the dues and the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. Just let me know when you’ve checked—it’s no trouble.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the dues plan to the others and see who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep track of who’s in and make a note of the dues.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring it up with the others and let you know who’s in. Then we can sort the dues plan together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — I heard the dues are due soon. Have they said how much it is this time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the exact amount yet, but I can ask around. I’ll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I’d appreciate that. I’m trying to plan for it before they collect.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the club dues. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can pay mine if you remind me how much it was.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — it was $20 this month. If you’ve got it now, I can take it and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — here’s the $20. Appreciate you taking care of it!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the club dues. I probably missed the notice; how much are they again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: They’re $20 this month. If you want, I can send you the payment details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — please send them over. I’ll take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with those dues if you need it—just let me know what’s due and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’ll check the amount and let you know exactly what’s due.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—just send me the amount when you’ve got it, and we’ll take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the dues. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — could you please bring the dues by tonight? I’ll be at the clubhouse around 7 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can bring the dues by around 7 tonight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help sort out the dues. What part are you looking at?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m trying to confirm which homes have paid and which ones still owe, so I can keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that—send me the list, and I’ll mark who’s paid and who still owes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m happy to help with the dues. If you’re ready, I can walk you through the amount and the best way to pay it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m ready. Please tell me the amount and how you’d like me to pay.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The dues are $20 for the month, and you can pay me in cash or by mobile transfer. If it’s easier, I can also note it down and you can bring it by later today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard a little second-hand about the dues—what’s the latest on them?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still checking the exact amount, but I can ask and let you know today. Do you want the breakdown too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — the breakdown would be really helpful. Thanks for checking and letting me know today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can probably do that—just remind me of the amount and when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — it’s $20, and it’s due by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, $20 by Friday — I’ll take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help with that. What do you need to know about the dues?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, how much are the dues and when are they due?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: They’re $20 a month, and they’re due by the 5th of each month.
